package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

var globalRouter = gin.New()

// scenario for route_groups_created_inside_handlers: Code that constructs or mutates route groups outside the startup router layer.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
func CreateGroupInsideHandler(c *gin.Context) {
	api := globalRouter.Group("/api")
	api.GET("/users", func(c *gin.Context) {
		c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"users": []string{}})
	})
	api.POST("/orders", func(c *gin.Context) {
		c.JSON(http.StatusCreated, gin.H{"id": 1})
	})
	c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"status": "routes added dynamically"})
}

func AnotherHandlerBuildingRoutes(c *gin.Context) {
	v2 := globalRouter.Group("/v2")
	v2.GET("/products", func(c *gin.Context) {
		c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"products": []string{}})
	})
	c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"status": "v2 routes added"})
}
